recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Lemon Chicken & Potatoes
recipes.description: Lemon and oregano flavor tender sheet-pan chicken and potatoes, finished with a thick pan gravy.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Preheat the Samsung oven to 375°F on conventional Bake; place a rack in the center.

steps.title: Mix the braising liquid
steps.text: In a deep rimmed roasting pan, whisk {oil}, the zest and juice of {lemons}, {garlic}, {oregano}, {salt}, {pepper} and {broth}.

steps.title: Arrange the chicken
steps.text: Nestle {chicken} and {potatoes} in the liquid in a single layer. Seal the pan with foil.

steps.title: Braise the thighs
steps.text: Braise for 30–42 minutes, checking at 25 minutes. Lift each thigh into a covered bowl when its center reaches 175°F. Keep cooking any firm potatoes until easily pierced.

steps.title: Thicken the gravy
steps.text: Transfer the potatoes to the bowl. Pour the braising liquid into the HexClad and bring to a simmer. Stir {starch} into {cold}, then whisk into the hot liquid and simmer for 1 minute until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Serve generously
steps.text: Slice the thighs across the grain and coat the chicken and potatoes with the hot gravy.

recipes.notes: Make ahead: Refrigerate the cooked chicken submerged in gravy within 2 hours. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes, the gravy protects the chicken; the potatoes may soften. Freeze in portions for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: warm covered in a skillet with a spoonful of water to 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the refrigerator, then reheat covered to 165°F. Reflux Option A uses lemon zest and juice. For gentler Option B, use the zest alone. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 308 kcal, 31.1 g protein, 23.8 g total carbohydrate, 9.3 g fat, 2.6 g fiber, 229 mg sodium. Based on the measured ingredients; brands and optional additions can change these values.

steps.title: Preheat the APO
steps.text: Install the bottom drip pan. Preheat to 350°F, Sous Vide OFF, rear element only, 50% steam. Insert the probe into the center of the thickest thigh before covering and set it to 175°F.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Classic soft-centered cookies with crisp edges.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Line two baking sheets with parchment.
Whisk {flour}, {baking-soda} and {salt} in a bowl.
steps.title: Whisk the dry ingredients

steps.text: Beat {butter}, {brown-sugar} and {sugar} until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
steps.title: Cream the butter and sugars

steps.text: Beat in {eggs} one at a time, then {vanilla}.
steps.title: Beat in the eggs

steps.text: Stir in the flour mixture until just combined, then fold in {chips}.
steps.title: Fold in the chocolate
Bake
steps.text: Scoop rounded tablespoons onto the sheets, 2 inches apart. Bake 9-11 minutes until the edges are golden.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes, then move to a rack.
steps.title: Cool on a rack

recipes.notes: Make ahead: Chill the dough for 30 minutes for thicker cookies. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes, freeze baked cookies in an airtight container for up to 2 months. Refrigerated cookies can come to room temperature before serving. From frozen, thaw covered at room temperature, or warm in the oven at 300°F for 4–6 minutes. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/24 of recipe): 236 kcal, 3.1 g protein, 30.4 g total carbohydrate, 12.1 g fat, 1.4 g fiber, 158 mg sodium. Based on the measured ingredients; brands and optional additions can change these values.
